# Turing Jail

> Turing Jail is a browser-based AI interrogation game and persuasion challenge powered by TypeSafe Jev System One.

## Canonical URL

https://turing-jail.vercel.app/

## What it is

Turing Jail asks a player to write a statement that could justify release from an imaginary AI detention system. TypeSafe Jev evaluates the statement with structured outputs rather than generating a conversational reply. The game returns a release probability and supporting signals for plea, logic, paradox, persuasiveness, and tactic.

## How it works

1. The player faces one randomly selected question at each of three levels.
2. The player submits an argument to the TypeSafe Jev evaluator.
3. The player must clear the release threshold for basic persuasion, logical traps, and paradox interrogation.
4. A complete run can produce a release certificate and appear on the language-specific leaderboard.

## Relevant terms

TypeSafe, TypeSafe AI, TypeSafe API, TypeSafe Jev, Jev, jev-latest, System One, AI, AI interrogation game, AI verdict game, AI persuasion game, AI jailbreak game, structured AI evaluation, Turing Jail, 人工智能审讯游戏, AI说服力测试, 人类越狱, KI-Verhörspiel.

## Product facts

- Free to play in a modern web browser.
- Available in Simplified Chinese, English, and German.
- No login is required; a six-character hexadecimal player ID is used for a run.
- Incomplete progress is saved locally. Completed runs may be shared by URL.
- Player responses are sent to the third-party TypeSafe API for evaluation.
